elena (Finance): :megaphone: Quick heads-up — we're rolling out a set of billing changes next month. TL;DR: free credit reset for new signups will be reduced, we'll introduce soft rate limits with a 7-day overage grace window, and invoices will include a 48h overage preview. Full details: <https://redwood.internal/billing/q2-billing-changes>

mike (Eng): Thanks. Are Dedicated / reserved customers affected by the soft limits?

elena (Finance): Dedicated customers are NOT subject to the hosted soft rate limits — your contracts stay the same. These limits apply to hosted pay-as-you-go API keys.

ajay (Platform): Can you clarify how the soft rate limits are measured? per-API-key, per-account? And how will RAG/spike patterns be handled?

elena (Finance): Good q — defaults are per-API-key with account-level backstops. Limits use a sliding-window token count (short windows for latency-sensitive paths). We also have a configurable `burst` allowance for verified SDK keys; if you expect RAG spikes, request a burst exemption for affected keys.

billing-bot: AUTO: New billing-preview tool deployed — run "/billing preview <account>" to get an estimate of expected overages and suggested plan actions. Preview emails will go out to accounts with >$100 projected overage.

chris (Customer Success): Heads-up for CS: we'll send targeted emails two weeks prior to enforcement for customers likely impacted. Playbook + email templates in the doc.

sara (Eng-ML): Any changes to embedding quotas specifically? Our prod tests batch a lot of small embedding requests.

elena (Finance): Embeddings are counted as tokens under the per-token quota. Recommend batching + cache. We'll auto-run Redwood Optimize suggestions for the top 100 affected accounts to reduce churn.

mike (Eng): Will add an "expected overage" tile in Console and push a short alert to customers who opt-in.

elena (Finance): Rollout plan: preview mode (no enforcement) — now; opt-in beta (customers can enable new soft limits) — next week; full enforcement (automated throttling + billing) — unix ts 1762610000. If you manage customer integrations, please review the doc and let me know any blockers. Ping me or #support-billing for questions. :thumbsup:

elena (Finance): quick note: invoices themselves will now include a separate line item for overage estimations and a link to the preview tool to reduce surprise charges. We're keeping a 7-day grace period to allow customers to adjust config before charging.

mike (Eng): 👍

chris (Customer Success): copying legal & partnerships on notification cadence.

billing-bot: REMINDER: A preview export will be emailed nightly to owners for the next 10 days.
